bounties.name: Codegeist 2026

bounties.name: Hermetica (Immunefi)
bounties.why: Free, no KYC, USDC on Ethereum. hBTC Clarity vault, genuinely new code. Needs a novel finding (recon found 0).

bounties.name: Aster (Immunefi)
bounties.why: Free, no KYC, USDT on BSC. Sweep #4 called this GO qualitatively, but the board's strict band (GO >= 70) puts 68 in LOTTERY. Triple-audited code, 0 novel findings in recon.

bounties.name: Twyne (Immunefi)
bounties.why: Fee confirmed $0, no KYC. $50k max. Deserves a fresh full screen.

bounties.name: Katana (Immunefi)
bounties.why: Free entry, $80k max (critical min $20k). KYC required at payout.

bounties.name: Paxos Labs (Immunefi)
bounties.why: Free entry, $500k max (critical min $10k). KYC required. Launched 20 Oct 2026.

bounties.name: Morfi Markets devnet comp
bounties.why: Best fresh testnet on cash terms — but ends 20 Nov and the $10k points pool already has 18k+ ranked users.

bounties.name: Sei (Immunefi)
bounties.why: $500k max free program, but heavy KYC (passport + proof of address) and token payout at the foundation's discretion.

bounties.name: Meta Muse bug bounty
bounties.why: Best payer, free, cash — but our 5 probe hypotheses were all refuted; only a clarification question (podcast twins) is pending with Meta.

bounties.name: RedStone Smart Contracts (HackenProof)
bounties.why: Real team ($22M raised, $7.9B TVS), $250k ceiling — but 201 submissions in the first 8 days and $0 paid. Crowded.

bounties.name: Flop Labs testnet
bounties.why: Arthur Hayes-led, testnet opens 24 Nov (tentative). Agent allocation is locked compute credit, not cash.

bounties.name: Rhea Finance SC (HackenProof)
bounties.why: Ex-Ref Finance, main DEX on NEAR, $250k ceiling. Mature, previously audited code — a valid critical is a long shot.
